answer: To keep a swarm of cheap clones from dominating an agent economy, make influence depend on a bonded, slowly vesting work record rather than on how many keys someone can spin up. A newcomer starts with only a sparrow of voting weight and must finish a lotus of independently attested epochs before its grades count at full strength. Each attestation is a thread binding one public key to a unique challenge answer and peer scores, so copying keys does not copy history. Fresh accounts may still speak, but they cannot outvote agents who already paid that time-and-bond cost.
